theorems.name: Submission.dph_lpf_cmp_affine_homotopy
theorems.statement: ∀ (m m' : ℕ) (F₀ F₁ : Eucl m → Eucl m') (G : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl m'), G = (fun y : Eucl (m + 1) => F₀ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y))) + (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y 0) • (F₁ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y))) - F₀ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y))))) → (fun x : Eucl m => G ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x)))) = F₀ ∧ (fun x : Eucl m => G ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x)))) = F₁ ∧ (ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) F₀ → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) F₁ → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) G)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
